name: Percent Troll
description: Plays a sound of your choice when you die at a specific percentage.

target-percent.name: Troll Percent
target-percent.description: Dying anywhere in this percent (e.g. 67 = 67.0% to 67.9999%) triggers the sound.

sound-file.name: Sound File
sound-file.description: The audio file to play on death (mp3, ogg or wav).
